title: Scam Calls

items.label: Unknown Caller
items.description: A phone rings from an unknown number as its owner looks uncertain.
items.visual_focus: A phone rings from an unknown number as its owner looks uncertain.
items.local_cue: a Bangladesh mobile-money user receiving a suspicious phone call, no legible brand, code, or personal data

items.label: Urgent Claim
items.description: The caller's speech bubble has an alarm symbol while the listener hesitates.
items.visual_focus: The caller's speech bubble has an alarm symbol while the listener hesitates.
items.local_cue: a Bangladesh mobile-money user receiving a suspicious phone call, no legible brand, code, or personal data

items.label: OTP Message
items.description: An unreadable one-time-code notification arrives on a phone while a call is active.
items.visual_focus: An unreadable one-time-code notification arrives on a phone while a call is active.
items.local_cue: a Bangladesh mobile-money user receiving a suspicious phone call, no legible brand, code, or personal data

items.label: Official-Sounding Call

items.visual_focus: A caller claims authority while the mobile-money user looks uncertain; no legible caller ID.
items.local_cue: a Bangladesh mobile-money user receiving a suspicious phone call, no legible brand, code, or personal data

items.label: Shared Code

items.visual_focus: A user nearly reads a one-time code aloud while speaking into a phone on speaker mode.

items.label: Empty Balance

items.visual_focus: After a suspicious call, a user stares at a nearly empty mobile-money balance bar.

questions: Which two scenes show the scammer's pressure?
What suspicious financial message have you seen?
Which is more persuasive: an urgent claim or an official-sounding caller?
Why might an urgent voice sound trustworthy?
If a user ignores all unknown calls, what might they miss?
What could you try in 7 days for at most 1,500 BDT? Who might pay if it worked?

starter_experiment.pilot: Ask twenty people how they judge sample calls and which warning signs they miss.
starter_experiment.potential_customer: MFS agents, schools, or community groups
starter_experiment.test_metric: Scam cues people miss and actions they would take
starter_experiment.note: Optional cash ceiling for a first experiment, not money required to begin or a full launch budget. Start with tools and relationships already available; pay partners fairly and account for founder time before scaling.
